findings.candidate_quote: Both investigational vaccines showed dose-dependent increases in neutralizing antibodies and T-cell responses
findings.reference_quote: one bivalent at three dose levels and one monovalent at one dose level
findings.explanation: The monovalent CV0601 vaccine was tested at only one dose, so the study could not establish dose-dependent antibody or T-cell responses for both vaccines. The reported dose-dependent neutralizing-antibody increase applied to CV0701.
